effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Mortefi menggunakan sepasang pistol dan api untuk melakukan hingga 4 tembakan beruntun, memberikan  Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description:
Mortefi memasuki mode Aiming untuk menembakkan serangan yang lebih kuat.
Tembakan yang dilepaskan setelah charge selesai memberikan  Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Menggunakan Stamina untuk melakukan beberapa tembakan ke arah target saat berada di udara, memberikan  Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah berhasil menghindar (Dodge) untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Menembakkan kilatan api ke depan, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Memberikan  Fusion DMG dan menerapkan efek Burning Rhapsody kepada semua anggota tim.

effects.title: Burning Rhapsody
effects.description:
Saat Basic Attack karakter aktif mengenai target, Mortefi akan melakukan Coordinated Attack, menembakkan 1 Marcato.
Saat Heavy Attack karakter aktif mengenai target, Mortefi akan melakukan Coordinated Attack, menembakkan 2 Marcato.
Mortefi dapat melakukan 1 Coordinated Attack setiap 0.35 detik.

effects.title: Marcato
effects.description: Menyerang target, memberikan  Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue
effects.description:
Saat Annoyance Mortefi mencapai 100, Resonance Skill akan berubah menjadi Fury Fugue.
Saat menggunakan Fury Fugue, Mortefi mengonsumsi seluruh Annoyance untuk menembakkan kilatan api berkecepatan tinggi, memberikan  Fusion DMG yang dihitung sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

effects.title: Annoyance
effects.description:
Mortefi dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Annoyance dan dapat memulihkannya melalui cara berikut:
Saat Normal Attack: Impromptu Show mengenai target.
Saat Intro Skill: Dissonance mengenai target.
Saat Resonance Skill: Passionate Variation mengenai target.
Dalam 5 detik setelah menggunakan Passionate Variation,
setiap Normal Attack: Impromptu Show yang mengenai target akan memulihkan Annoyance tambahan.
Setelah menggunakan Resonance Skill: Passionate Variation, DMG dari Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue meningkat 25% selama 8 detik
Saat dalam efek Burning Rhapsody, setiap serangan Marcato dari Resonance Liberation akan meningkatkan DMG dari Marcato berikutnya sebesar 1.5%.
Efek ini dapat dipicu setiap 0.35 detik, hingga 50 stack(s).
Efek ini akan dihapus setelah Burning Rhapsody berakhir.
Mortefi menyerang target, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Resonator yang masuk mendapatkan 38% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification selama 14 detik atau hingga mereka diganti.
Saat berada dalam Burning Rhapsody, Mortefi akan melakukan Coordinated Attack saat Resonator di medan pertempuran menggunakan Resonance Skill,
menembakkan 2 Marcato yang memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Setelah menggunakan Echo Skill, Mortefi memulihkan tambahan 10 Resonance Energy.
Dapat dipicu setiap 20 detik.
Saat berada dalam Burning Rhapsody, Crit. DMG dari Marcato meningkat 30%.
Durasi Burning Rhapsody diperpanjang 7 detik.
Saat Resonance Skill: Passionate Variation atau Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue mengenai target, akan memicu Coordinated Attack yang menembakkan 4 Marcato, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
DMG dari Marcato yang ditembakkan dengan cara ini dikurangi 50%.
Saat Resonance Liberation: Violent Finale digunakan, ATK semua anggota tim meningkat 20% selama 20 detik.

Info.Content:
Mortefi, a skilled expert in Applied Tacetite Study and a member of the Academy’s Department of Safety, possesses the unique ability to transform his accumulated frustration into fiery flames.
From a burning wrath that consumes all, the red dragon shall descend.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2183-G]

According to Resonator Mortefi's reports, indications of his Awakening began to manifest during his youth. His actual Awakening was accompanied by a surge of intense anger.

Mortefi's Tacet Mark is located on his right chest. When Mortefi's Forte is activated, crystalline matter in the shape of dragon scales materializes around his Tacet Mark. These scales burn intensely as he harnesses his power.

Resonator Mortefi demonstrates the ability to generate and manipulate fire through the focused concentration of heat. The intensity of the flames produced is closely linked to Mortefi's emotional state. Extensive experimentation has revealed that the fire is a tangible manifestation of Mortefi's accumulated negative emotions over a certain threshold.

The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Mortefi has been observed to align closely with that of the Dragonkin, a species that is currently declared extinct. Due to the unavailability of living Dragonkin for Syntony tests, it is currently not possible to empirically confirm the cause of Mortefi's Awakening.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve, with a steep rise in its middle section. Resonator Mortefi is thereby classified as a Mutant Resonator.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
Resonator Mortefi's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is regular, though the peak values show an increasing tendency. Peak values are currently under Criticality level, and abnormal waveforms are not identified.

Resonant Criticality: High, combined with low stability. A high risk of Overclocking is present.

Resonator Mortefi has a documented history of Overclocking. Maximum Overclocking rating: Moderate.

During Overclocking, the scale-shaped red crystalline matter on Mortefi's chest continuously expands to cover a larger area of his skin. This transformation is accompanied by a significant rise in body temperature, resulting in the manifestation of intense Frequency Fluctuation. Notably, a fiery apparition resembling a dragon becomes visible behind Mortefi during this stage.

Mortefi was the cause of a major fire in Desorock Highland. This event was classified under code EX67891 as a Class 3 hazard. Fortunately, no casualties were reported. Resonator Mortefi's Forte and Overclocking history indicate that negative emotions are his primary trigger for Overclocking, which warrants a higher risk of Overclocking. Therefore, it is recommended to closely monitor Resonator Mortefi's psychological status and implement regular counseling and examinations.
